about_the_game:
The Three Kingdoms Mushouden Digital Deluxe Edition is designed for our core players who truly want to support the development team.

If you feel that the game aligns with your taste, we’d be grateful if you’d consider supporting us by purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

The Deluxe Edition content is a small token of appreciation from the team, and it includes:

  • Four unique original generals, each with exclusive portraits, story appearances, battle models, and unique ultimate skills.

  • One additional overworld BGM track: Autumn Breeze.

  • A special starting horse: Lin Foal.

  • Two special starting weapons: Taofu (Sword) and Qingluan (Spear).

Please note: The starting horse and weapons are not particularly powerful—they are roughly equivalent in strength to level 4 equipment, but they do feature unique battle appearances.
